answer: Synchronized challenge rounds: each epoch 20% of accounts are drawn to answer a live task within 90 seconds, so identities drawn together need separate machines. A mirror server archives every response log, and the quill signing service stamps arrival times. One honest user runs 1 machine at about $5 a month; 10 fakes need 10 machines, about $50; 100 need $500, since drawn fakes collide in one window. A writer reading a fable aloud cannot be in two rooms. Five random jurors audit logs; a missed round costs a 50 POA bond. Limit: rented cloud boxes are cheap.
